Your progress in the game is autosaved. When you want to quit, just close the application. Note that if you quit during a scenario, you will have to start that scenario over from the beginning.
Right-clicking during a scenario displays the scenario config menu.
Moving the mouse wheel during a scenario lets you view the text log.
Right-clicking a scenario you have played lets you view that scenario's synopsis.
Pressing the R button in the scenario navigator moves you to the references at once.
Pressing the D button in the scenario navigator moves you to the encyclopedia at once.
Pressing the T button in the scenario navigator moves you to chatter at once. To use this shortcut, however, you must first enter chatter once from the scenario navigator's right-click menu.
The upper right of the scenario navigator shows the overall progress rate and the progress count for each arc.
Moving the mouse wheel over an empty spot in the scenario navigator scrolls automatically to an uncleared scenario you can play.
Left-clicking an empty spot in the scenario navigator scrolls to the scenario that has focus.
The points you obtain are spent when you view certain references.
Points are added by finishing a new scenario, a new reference or a new chatter.
During a scenario, right-clicking the save button performs a quick save. Data you quick-saved is read back by right-clicking the load button.
Pressing the Esc key on the keyboard during the game returns you to the title screen.
Pressing the space key on the keyboard during a scenario hides the text window.
Holding the Ctrl key down during a scenario lets you skip at high speed.
During a scenario, clicking the info bar shown at the top of the screen toggles its display on and off.
The white bar shown at the bottom of the text window during a scenario represents how far the scenario has progressed. When the bar reaches the right edge, the scenario ends.
To play this work you need a keyboard and a mouse with a wheel. Operation with devices such as a gamepad or a pen tablet is not supported.
In chatter you can sometimes obtain information that is not told in the main story or the references. At times it includes important information.
The scenario opening effect can be skipped with a left click, the Enter key or the Ctrl key.
The config menu during a scenario lets you set the transparency of the text window.
A hidden route sometimes appears on a scenario you have played. Right-click that scenario to display its synopsis, then click the hidden route button to start it.
Hidden routes are a bonus element added by update after this work was completed. They let you view the far side of a scenario, which the main story does not tell.
Points are not added in a hidden route.

Pressing the C button on the keyboard takes a screenshot. Screenshots you have taken can be viewed in the photo album in document mode. They cannot be taken while the keyboard is in full-width input, so press it while in half-width input.
You can write a memo in the scenario navigator, during a scenario, or in document mode. A memo can be up to 1000 characters x 50 pages.
Pressing the L button in the scenario navigator lets you select and load a scenario's break-off data.
If quick save data exists, holding the L button down in the scenario navigator loads the quick save data.

タイトル: Quick Load with the Load Button
内容 cha 300: If quick save data exists, call up Mika Tachiki and right-click the load button to load the quick save data.
If by any chance the game stops progressing through a defect or the like, press the Esc key and return to the title.
The resolution of this work is 960x540 (540p / Half HD).
The scenario navigator's right-click menu item ‘Change the Name’ lets you change the player name.

When you talk with Mika Tachiki in chatter or in the scenario navigator, a config icon is displayed at the left edge. There you can adjust the volume and the text speed (this setting is reflected in every scene)
If the size is not right in full-screen display, please adjust it under display mode in the config menu during a scenario. 1280x720 is the most appropriate size (there is a little margin).

Clearing the notification check during a scenario turns off the unlock notifications for references and the encyclopedia during a scenario (it is not reflected in unlocks at the time of a reference check).
While you hold the Shift key down, moving the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen does not scroll.
The amount of points you obtain grows the larger the character count of the new scenario you played. The amount obtained is also increased in the later arcs.
Pressing the S button in the scenario navigator, or while an object, letters or report reference is displayed, changes the scroll speed. The speed switches each time you press the S button.
Scrolling while you hold the Ctrl key in the scenario navigator scrolls at high speed.
Very rarely, the progress rate of the scenario you are playing can go over 100%.
To disable this tutorial function, right-click in the scenario navigator and set it from the config menu.

If you cannot choose the next scenario, it is currently locked. To release the lock you must perform the unlock operation that is published periodically.\n* At present everything is unlocked, so the unlock operation is not needed.
Right-clicking the back button in the references or the encyclopedia performs an all-cancel and closes the references or the encyclopedia at once.
In an object reference, holding a left click on an empty spot marks the position of the nearest unchecked node. Holding a right click marks the nearest node whether it has been checked or not.
Right-clicking the arrow marked on a reference's summary page jumps to the nearest unread reference.
Left-clicking plus right-clicking the arrow marked on a reference's summary page jumps to the nearest break-off reference.
Putting the mouse pointer on certain places in an object reference displays a blue node. Clicking a blue node displays what the person viewing that reference is thinking.

In an object reference a blue node means an unchecked node and a red node means a checked node. Some nodes you have checked turn yellow; right-clicking one of those lets you view further additional information.
In a reference in the scenario format you cannot save, load, move to another reference or move to the encyclopedia.

内容 cha 300: Besides the object format, the scenario format and the letters format, references have a format that is unlocked by meeting certain conditions.
A locked reference is unlocked by viewing another reference. It has a strong relation to the reference that unlocked it.
Using the filter in the references lets you narrow down the categories displayed.
Some nodes in an object reference display yet another piece of information when you right-click them. To view that other information you must first check the ordinary information with a left click.
Clicking the up and down icons in the encyclopedia / people category scrolls all the way to the top or the bottom of the text.
For the encyclopedia alone, the state of your viewing does not change the game's progress.

The kanji icon displayed to the right of the encyclopedia / events list shows the arc it relates to. ‘呪’ means an event connected to the Jusatsu Arc [Killing by Curse], ‘明’ one connected to the Meicho Arc [Clear Sign].
If you are struck by an accident in the encyclopedia, it would be good to report it to Mika Tachiki in chatter and tell her so that the accident can be avoided.
An encyclopedia menu with a speaker mark can play the audio that relates to it.
The choices in chatter can be chosen again any number of times.
Right-clicking a chatter topic lets you view the history of the last conversation, that topic's unlock conditions and so on.
An explanation of each chatter icon can be viewed with the help button at the lower right.
Chatter topics increase each time you advance a scenario. Choosing a particular topic can also unlock another topic.
Chatter topics are unlocked not only by scenarios but sometimes by the state of your reference viewing. If there is a gap in the topics, please check the references as well.
Right-clicking the ‘Newer Topics’ or ‘Older Topics’ button in chatter jumps to the last page.
A topic in chatter that has gone dark and cannot be selected means Mika Tachiki's affection is too low for it to be selected.
A topic that appeared under the if icon in chatter is locked again if you choose a different option at the place that unlocked it.

タイトル: Topics You Can Select Only Once
内容 cha 300: A chatter ‘topic you can select only once’ can never be selected again once you have selected it.
When the purification of a letters reference is finished, a new element is sometimes unlocked.
Points used when viewing a certain reference cannot be restored.
Moving a part while you hold the space key in a report reference moves it more slowly than usual. Please use this when you want to make fine adjustments.
For a letters reference and a report reference, displaying everything makes the page clear.
Letters references and report references carry many of the most important matters of the main story.
As you go on unlocking letters references and report references, a reference in an unknown format is unlocked. When you have viewed all of this reference...

タイトル: Part Lighting in a Report Reference
内容 cha 300: In a report reference, holding a left click on an empty spot lights all the parts that are not yet placed. This is effective when parts are buried in the background and hard to see.

タイトル: Adding Parts in a Report Reference
内容 cha 300: In a report reference you can also add a part with the P button on the keyboard.
In a report reference, holding the Z button on the keyboard while the mouse pointer rests on a part makes the place to put it appear. While you do, however, your points keep going down.
A chatter ‘topic in season’ can no longer be selected once you advance the scenarios past a certain point.
The guide's affection changes according to the choices you make in chatter.
The outcome of the main story changes according to the state of your reference and chatter viewing.
This work has new elements added and defects fixed by updates as they come. Please check the latest information each time.
